purpose: Receipt the seven public ESOC GPS-week-2044 orbit and clock products, inspect only CLK headers, derive exact E14 source epochs and circular-control identities from SP3 geometry, and freeze the response parser before any clock value is decoded.

format_contract.clk: RINEX CLOCK 2.00; inspect through END OF HEADER only in this package; response successor may parse only records whose first two characters are AS and whose PRN field is exactly E14
format_contract.sp3: SP3 dV; GPS time; 300 s nominal cadence; P coordinates in km; clock column ignored
format_contract.epoch_key: integer UTC-like calendar tuple exactly as printed by both products; products declare GPS time and are matched without conversion or interpolation
format_contract.daily_window: exact E14 SP3 epochs advertised by each daily file; response successor intersects E14 CLK epochs and excludes the first and last common epoch of each day

source_only_selection.circular_control_rule: Among non-E14/non-E18 Galileo PRNs present at every SP3 epoch on all seven days, rank ascending by population standard deviation of geocentric radius divided by mean radius; break ties by PRN; freeze the first two. No CLK value rows may be read for this selection.
source_only_selection.orbital_period_rule: On the continuous E14 geocentric-radius series, retain the earlier daily solution at a duplicated midnight (response edges are excluded later), subtract its mean, compute the positive-lag pair-normalized autocorrelation for lags 100 through 220 samples, and freeze the lag with the largest correlation; break ties toward smaller lag.
source_only_selection.phase_scramble_rule: After the source-only period is frozen, use circular source-template shifts round(P/8), round(P/4), round(3P/8), and round(P/2), plus their negatives, deduplicated and sorted.

known_product_correction.frozen_fact: The ESOC preprocessing already includes the standard eccentric relativistic correction 2 r dot v / c^2; the response successor tests a residual causal-memory quadrature and does not call the CLK series uncorrected proper time.
known_product_correction.primary_source: S. Herrmann et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 121, 231102 (2018), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.121.231102
known_product_correction.interpretation_boundary: The seven-day product has no onboard temperature, magnetic-field, clock-identity, attitude, or SLR residual series; those controls remain unavailable rather than imputed.
